statement: One can fix α0 sufficiently large and then ℓ∗ > 0 sufficiently small so that every normalized nonnegative bosonic ground function satisfies, for every A ⊂ L, µ{nBv < ℓ∗D for every v ∈ A} ≤ (C/D2 )|A| . (2.12) The estimate holds for all sufficiently large D, uniformly in K and the ground function.
